announcements.text: SecuriGence LLC, Leesburg, Virginia, has been awarded a $121,521,288 modification (P00081) to previously awarded task order HR001121F0006 for information technology multi-network support services. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the task order to $816,412,874 from $694,891,586. Work will be performed in Arlington, Virginia, with an expected completion date of June 2027. Fiscal 2025 research and development funds in the amount of $26,849,189, are being obligated at time of award. The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, Arlington, Virginia, is the contracting activity.

Rune Technologies Inc.,* Arlington, Virginia, was awarded a $99,000,000 firm-fixed-price contract for the TyrOS logistical operations software platform. Bids were solicited via the internet with one received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of June 15, 2031. Army Contracting Command, Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland, is the contracting activity (W9128Z-26-D-A002).

Bodwe-KVG JV LLC,* Dowagiac, Michigan, was awarded a $35,678,310 firm-fixed-price contract for the procurement of boxed, ready-to-eat meals. Bids were solicited via the internet with six received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Dec. 31, 2026. U.S. Property and Fiscal Office, District of Columbia, is the contracting activity (W912R1-26-F-A024).

Raytheon Co., Richardson, Texas, was awarded a $27,345,376 modification (P00009) to contract W56KGY-23-D-0005 to support continued execution of mission requirements under the cross-domain services framework, including compliance, equipment procurement, site readiness, technical integration, and expanded capabilities at an additional government-directed location. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $72,786,522. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of May 9, 2028. Army Contracting Command, Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

Allen, Williford and Seale Inc.,* Houston, Texas, was awarded a $25,000,000 firm-fixed-price contract for professional real estate appraisal services. Bids were solicited via the internet with one received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of June 15, 2031. U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Fort Worth, Texas, is the contracting activity (W9126G-26-D-A034).

Integra Realty Resources-Phoenix, Phoenix, Arizona, was awarded a $25,000,000 firm-fixed-price contract for professional real estate appraisal services. Bids were solicited via the internet with one received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of June 15, 2031. U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Fort Worth, Texas, is the contracting activity (W9126G-26-D-A035).

MDB Group LLC,* Lorton, Virginia, was awarded a cost-plus-fixed-fee contract for analytic and program support. The amount of this action is $13,647,320, with a total cumulative face value of $101,819,710. Bids were solicited via the internet with 11 received. Work will be performed in Washington, D.C., with an estimated completion date of Jan. 22, 2032. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance, Army funds in the amount of $10,000,000 were obligated at the time of the award. Army Contracting Command, Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland, is the contracting activity (W91CRB-26-C-A012).

Babington Technology Inc.,* Rocky Mount, North Carolina, has been awarded a maximum $25,760,000 fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity with economic-price-adjustment contract for tray ration heater system items. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. Code 3204 (a)(1), as stated in the Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-1. This is a five-year contract with no option periods. The ordering period end date is June 16, 2031. Using military services are Army and Marine Corps. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2026 through 2031 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (SPE3SE-26-D-0003).

Meggitt Defense Systems Inc., doing business as Parker Meggitt Defense Systems Division, Irvine, California, is awarded a $22,471,439 firm-fixed-price contract for the production and delivery of F/A-18 Infrared Search and Track (IRST) Environmental Control Unit (ECU) Weapons Replaceable Assemblies in support of full-rate production requirements for the Navy. The ECU provides cooling for critical IRST components, ensuring system reliability and performance. Work will be performed in Irvine, California, and is expected to be completed in February 2030. Fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $10,712,079; fiscal 2026 working capital (Navy) funds in the amount of $1,785,347; and fiscal 2025 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of 9,974,014, will be obligated at the time of award. This contract was not competed. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity (N0001926C0134).

Davis Defense Group LLC, Stafford, Virginia, is being awarded a $20,496,578 firm-fixed-price and cost reimbursement (travel only) contract bridge with a 12-month period of performance for academic support services in support of the Marine Corps University. The contract period of performance is from July 1, 2026, to June 30, 2027. This contract requires multiple performance locations across the Marine Corps University campuses. The majority of the work will be done at the Marine Corps University facilities in Quantico, Virginia. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance (Marine Corps) funds in the amount of $18,869,034 will be obligated at the time of award and will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. Subsequent contract modifications to incorporate funding will utilize fiscal year operations and maintenance (Marine Corps) funds available at time of execution. A contract bridge request and justification and approval for this contract bridge are on file. The Marine Corps Installations National Capital Region-Regional Contracting Office, Quantico, Virginia, is the contracting activity. (M00264-26-C-0002).

EMS Development Corp., Yaphank, New York, is being awarded $9,299,836 for a firm-fixed-price contract for the procurement of 308 outboard magnetometers used on Virginia-class submarines. The contract does not contain an option provision. All work will be performed in Yaphank, New York, and is expected to be completed by December 2028. Fiscal 2026 working capital funds (Navy) in the contract’s full amount of $9,299,836 will be obligated at time of award and funds will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. One company was solicited for this sole-source requirement pursuant to the authority set forth in 10 U.S. Code 3204 (a)(1) and one offer received. Naval Supply Systems Command Weapon Systems Support, Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania, is the contracting activity (N00104-26-C-NA16).
